predictions.why: If the plain base's T 1.0 loss (224 vs 305-319 at T 0.6) mostly comes from the terse register missing end-of-text and running on, then cutting the tail with min-p 0.1 should restore clean stopping on short problems, as cool sampling does. It also brings back some loops on long problems, as min-p did for the cued base (cap hits 27 to 58, 410 to 404), so the score lands near the T 0.6 plain level and stays well under the cue.
